newsitem.title: USA: Ultra Pac encouraged by turnaround.
newsitem.headline: Ultra Pac encouraged by turnaround.

text.p: Ultra Pac Inc, which makes food packaging, said Thursday it is encouraged by the progress of its turnaround.
Ultra Pac reported earnings for the second quarter ended July 31 of $0.19 a share, up from $0.01 a year ago. In the first half it earned $0.11 a share, up from $0.09.

Ultra Pac said the second quarter profit followed three quarters of losses. It attributed the profit to a modest increase in revenues compared with the fiscal first quarter, a reduced fixed cost structure and a decline in raw material costs.
In the first quarter ended April 30, Ultra Pac reported revenues of $15.8 million and a net loss of $0.09 a share.
The company said it took a charge of $459,638 in the second quarter to write down the value of its recycling equipment, which it has not operated since August 1995.

"We are treating this entire fiscal year as one of team building and repositioning," Cal Krupa, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "We'll continue in this mode in the second half, while also anticipating the market softness that typically comes into play at this time of year."
